Still bummed as I was in Tokyo for a week, so it would've been pretty cool to at least go for one day. Also, would be curious if anybody did that Stars Wars Galactic Cruise or whatever that thing was called before they shut that down.  I will admit that I was tempted, but again, after what I saw that costs!  Makes that trip I took to the Netherlands for my 55th birthday in 2024 look cheap by comparison!
